remarks: Discover the perfect blend of suburban sophistication and urban convenience in this beautifully appointed 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse in the heart of downtown Stamford. A grand entrance with porch and portico welcomes you into a spacious open floor plan featuring a sun-filled living room, dining area, charming balcony, and a large eat-in kitchen ideal for everyday living and entertaining.  The home offers three generously sized bedrooms with ample closet space, plus the luxury of a 2-car attached garage with a walk-in storage closet. Enjoy a truly walkable lifestyle-steps to train stations, parks, shops, pickleball courts, restaurants, movies, and live entertainment. This upscale residence delivers the perfect balance of style, comfort, and effortless downtown living.
